LESSON: COMMON GREETINGS AND FAREWELL.

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 1.1: Common greetings and farewell.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Common greetings and farewell.. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Respond appropriately to time related greetings at home and at school.
2. Respond appropriately to farewell at home and at school.
3. Respond appropriately to farewell with reference to time at home and at school. e) Enjoy responding appropriately to greetings and farewell at home and at school. opportunity arises’. charts of people greeting that are displayed on walls. clips of people greeting and bidding farewell recorded in devices and practise responding to greetings and bidding farewell. attention to other greeting and farewell opportunities that arise at home and at school. Core-competence developed: Communication and collaboration, digital literacy , learning to learn

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Respond appropriately to time related greetings at home and at school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respond appropriately to time related greetings at home and at school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Respond appropriately to farewell at home and at school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respond appropriately to farewell at home and at school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Core-competence developed: Communication and collaboration, digital literacy , learning to learn. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Common greetings and farewell..
2. Explain Common greetings and farewell. to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Common greetings and farewell..
4. Show that you can: Respond appropriately to time related greetings at home and at school.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Common greetings and farewell.. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Common greetings and farewell. important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Respond appropriately to time related greetings at home and at school.
2. Respond appropriately to farewell at home and at school.
